name: Hirado (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hirado city emblem in green, blue and orange: a green and blue stylised figure with brush-stroke arms and an orange head.
history: Municipal flag of Hirado, a city in Nagasaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Hirado city emblem — a green and blue stylised figure with brush-stroke arms and an orange head
